# Klarweg GitHub Pages publication allowlist (P0-01 remediation)
#
# This file is the single source of truth for what gets published to
# GitHub Pages. Everything NOT listed here (explicitly, or via the two
# proven-safe glob patterns marked below) stays in the repository but
# is never copied into the deployment artifact.
#
# Format: one repo-relative path per line. Blank lines and lines
# starting with # are ignored. No trailing slashes on directories.
#
# Each root-level file's inclusion was individually verified this
# session: either it's a page users navigate to directly, or grep
# confirmed at least one live page actually references it
# (<script src>, <link href>, or fetch()). Nothing here is a guess.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Chapter system: two glob patterns, PROVEN this session to match
# exactly the legitimate files and nothing else.
#
#   chapter/chapter-*.html   -> matches exactly the 258 pages linked
#                                from a1.html-c2.html's own hrefs
#                                (diffed byte-for-byte against disk;
#                                zero extra, zero missing matches)
#   chapter/chapter-*-data.js -> matches exactly the 258 corresponding
#                                data files (same proof)
#
# These are glob patterns, not literal lines, because 516 files is
# impractical to hand-list and the glob is provably exact against the
# CURRENT repo. The workflow's own post-build assertion step (see
# deploy-pages.yml) is the safety net against a FUTURE internal file
# accidentally matching one of these patterns.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
GLOB:chapter/chapter-*.html
GLOB:chapter/chapter-*-data.js

# Exactly 7 named shared runtime files chapter pages depend on.
# (The other ~140 files in chapter/ - CLICKABILITY-AUDIT.md,
# BUILD_INFLECTION_INDEX.md, internal QA .js/.json scripts, etc. -
# are deliberately excluded; none of them are named below, and none
# match either glob above.)
chapter/chapter-app.js
chapter/chapter.css
chapter/chapter-tutor.js

# N1 fix: these 4 were omitted from the original allowlist despite
# being real, required dependencies - story-lexicon.js, tokenizer.js,
# and chapter-story.js are directly <script src>'d by all 258/258
# chapter pages; global-lexicon.js is dynamically injected by
# chapter-app.js (s.src = 'global-lexicon.js') on every chapter load.
# Their absence broke tap-any-word, vocabulary-card rendering, and
# story/dialogue rendering site-wide. Verified via grep across all
# 258 chapter-*.html files before adding these lines.
chapter/story-lexicon.js
chapter/tokenizer.js
chapter/chapter-story.js
chapter/global-lexicon.js

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Issue reporting: exactly 2 files out of the whole report/ directory.
# report/README.md documents both as "Published to GitHub Pages" —
# report/kw-report.js is dynamically <script src>'d by chapter-app.js
# (line ~431) on every chapter page, and it in turn injects a <link>
# to report/kw-report.css from the same directory. Verified via grep
# that neither file references any other same-origin path (only the
# separate klarweg-reports Worker API, an external Turnstile script,
# and in-memory blob URLs) — these two files are the complete public
# surface of report/.
#
# Everything else in report/ - report/worker/ (a separate, complete
# Cloudflare Worker: source, wrangler.toml, an admin-credential
# hashing tool, an admin dashboard), _dev-admin.html, _dev-admin-
# mock.js, _dev-harness.html, _dev-worker-tests.html, _dev-
# responsive.html, _dev-stage5.html, _dev-mocks.js, README.md,
# build-section-refs.mjs, section-refs.json - stays excluded. The
# workflow's post-build assertion step (see deploy-pages.yml) is the
# safety net enforcing that report/ can never publish anything beyond
# these 2 named files, the same pattern already used for chapter/.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
report/kw-report.js
report/kw-report.css
